matters.title: Recommendation to Approve a Single Source Purchase Agreement and Blanket Purchase Order with OverDrive, Inc. for Digital Resources — Christal Bell-Rivera, Library Services Department Director
matters.text:
That the Board take the following action concerning a Single Source Purchase Agreement and a Blanket Purchase Order with OverDrive, Inc.
A. Approve and authorize the County Administrator or designee to sign an Agreement between Escambia County, Florida and OverDrive, Inc. for the provision of digital resources to support the Libby platform; and
B. Approve and authorize the County Administrator or designee to issue and sign a Blanket Purchase Order in the amount of $600,000 to OverDrive, Inc. for the purchase of digital resources.

Description of OverDrive Advantage 2.0:
• Custom collections for your library within the shared collection website. OverDrive Advantage is a
program that enables members of OverDrive-powered shared collections or consortia to add a custom
collection exclusively for their patrons. These individual libraries, upon enrolling in OverDrive
Advantage, may purchase digital titles in formats that their shared collection supports (e.g., audiobooks,
eBooks, music and/or video) and make them available to their patrons within their shared collection’s
OverDrive-powered “virtual branch” website.
• Benefits. Advantage members may reduce waiting lists by purchasing additional copies of popular titles
and making them available only to their patrons. Advantage members may also create custom
collections by purchasing titles that are not in the shared collection but are of interest to their
community. The Advantage member library’s titles will appear on the same OverDrive-powered website
their patrons have always used, eliminating the need for additional URLs and links.
• Advantage 2.0 Titles and Materials. All material purchased by participating Advantage library are for the
exclusive use of the Advantage library patrons. Advantage materials will not be visible to other consortia
members. Advantage library patrons will be asked to sign into their library accounts in order to see the
additional titles and to check out advantage material.

On November 24, 2024, Escambia County entered into a Library Participation Agreement
with the Panhandle Library Access Network, Inc. {PLAN). Under this agreement, OverDrive,
Inc. is designated as the exclusive provider of the proprietary Libby® digital content
platform used by the consortium.
The Libby platform enables the County to provide publisher-licensed eBooks, audiobooks,
and digital magazines to library patrons. This service is not a standalone content purchase;
it is a fully integrated digital lending system that includes patron authentication, digital
rights management (ORM), collection development tools, lending controls, reporting
features, and compatibility with the County's existing library management systems.
OverDrive owns and maintains the Libby platform, its supporting infrastructure, and the
associated content distribution network. The platform operates under proprietary
technology and publisher licensing agreements that are exclusively administered through
OverDrive. No third-party vendor is authorized to provide access to Libby, replicate its
functionality within the PLAN consortium structure, or distribute the same licensed digital
content under the same terms.
Because the County participates in the PLAN consortium and Libby is the consortium's
designated and integrated digital content platform, transitioning to another provider would
require withdrawal from the consortium, loss of shared collections, disruption of patron
services, and significant operational and financial impacts. No other vendor can provide
continuation of these services within the existing consortium framework.
For these reasons, OverDrive, Inc. is the only responsible source capable of providing the
required digital library platform and associated services, making this a valid single source
procurement.

SUBJECT: Recommendation to Approve a Single Source Purchase Agreement and Blanket
Purchase Order with OverDrive, Inc. for Digital Resources — Christal Bell-Rivera, Library Services
Department Director
RECOMMENDATION/REQUIRED ACTION:
That the Board take the following action concerning a Single Source Purchase Agreement and a
Blanket Purchase Order with OverDrive, Inc.
A. Approve and authorize the County Administrator or designee to sign an Agreement between
Escambia County, Florida and OverDrive, Inc. for the provision of digital resources to support the
Libby platform; and
B. Approve and authorize the County Administrator or designee to issue and sign a Blanket Purchase
Order in the amount of $600,000 to OverDrive, Inc. for the purchase of digital resources.
Vendor/Contractor Fund Amount
OverDrive Inc. Fund 113 $600,000
Cost Center 110501
Object Code 55401
BACKGROUND SUMMARY:
West Florida Public Library provides residents access to digital reading and listening materials
through subscription-based digital library services that provide eBook and audiobook access through
OverDrive’s proprietary Libby platform. The service includes platform hosting, maintenance, digital
rights management (DRM), collection management tools, reporting features, and integration with the
County’s Integrated Library System (ILS).
On November 24, 2024, Escambia County entered into a Library Participation Agreement with the
Panhandle Library Access Network, Inc. (PLAN). Under this agreement, OverDrive, Inc. is
designated as the exclusive provider of the proprietary Libby® digital content platform used by the
consortium.
The Libby platform enables the County to provide publisher-licensed eBooks, audiobooks, and digital
magazines to library patrons. This service is not a standalone content purchase; rather, it is a fully
integrated digital lending system that includes patron authentication, digital rights management
(DRM), collection development tools, lending controls, reporting capabilities, and compatibility with
the County’s existing library management systems.
OverDrive, Inc. owns and maintains the Libby platform, its supporting infrastructure, and the
associated content distribution network. The platform operates under proprietary technology and
publisher licensing agreements that are exclusively administered through OverDrive, Inc. No third-
party vendor is authorized to provide access to the Libby platform, replicate its functionality within the
PLAN consortium structure, or distribute the same licensed digital content under the same terms.
Because Escambia County participates in the PLAN consortium and Libby is the consortium’s
designated and integrated digital content platform, transitioning to another provider would require
withdrawal from the consortium, loss of shared collections, disruption of patron services, and
significant operational and financial impacts. No other vendor can provide continuation of these
services within the existing consortium framework.
For these reasons, OverDrive, Inc. is the only responsible source capable of providing the required
digital library platform and associated services. Accordingly, this purchase qualifies as a Single
Source procurement.
FISCAL IMPACT:
Funding for this purchase was approved in the Fiscal Year 2025-2026 Budget.

Clint,
Our customers typically buy in full truckload quantities as anything over 6 pallets is considered FTL
freight rates.
As illustrated below, price per ft²is equal per product. An operation your size buys 500# bulk sacks long
as you have a machine to lift them to the applicator.
1. Posi-Shell 50# bags = 60/pallet or 900/truckload
1. $38.50 per bag plus freight $4900 (today’s rate)
2. 900 bags = 720,000 ft² coverage for alternative daily cover
3. $39,550 / 720,000 ft² = $.055 ft²
2. Posi-Shell 500# bulk sacks = 4/pallet or 84/truckload
1. $382.00 per bulk sack plus freight $4900 (today’s rate)
2. 84 sacks = 672,000 ft² coverage for alternative daily cover
3. $36,988 / 672,000 ft² = $.055 ft²
I can provide a formal quote in January when you are ready to place your first order.
Happy Holidays, Bob
